entries.title: Draft: Exp(1) FPP diagonal lower bounds in d18 and d19 by unique-height renewal (w685)
entries.statement: OWNER WORKING DRAFT: proof (unaudited); internal self-audit CLEAN, independent review pending, novelty unverified. In undirected nearest-neighbour FPP on Z^d with independent Exp(1) edge times, define mu_diag(d)=lim_k T(0,k(1,...,1))/(k sqrt(d)). The candidate lower bounds are mu_diag(18)>=0.080099928228 and mu_diag(19)>=0.077855718601. The exact (s,z) points are (31010781/500000,1612528463/500000000) for d18 and (1312953/20000,64604651/20000000) for d19. Three-step chords, eligible even square alternatives, and odd square alternatives at globally unique heights give disjoint off-path edge sets for each fixed simple path. Shared actual-edge times are integrated jointly by a 641-state pending-moment transfer. Irreducible height bridges form a renewal operator B; exact common-norm and scalar-tail checks plus outward arithmetic verify Bv<=kappa v on 330 positive boundary coordinates with kappa<1 in each dimension. The all-length initial and terminal pieces have negative-step quotas 4m>=n-17 and 4m>=n-1. These yield a finite tilted Laplace sum and the FPP bound sqrt(d) log(z)/s; exact downward logarithm and square-root arithmetic gives the displayed floors. These are proof candidates rather than independently checked FPP bounds. The reviewed C003-v2 fallback remains 0.080065422991 (d18) and 0.077824524846 (d19). No d18 non-ball conclusion or novelty finding follows from this card.
assumptions: undirected nearest-neighbour lattice Z^d with d=18 or d=19
exact parameter-specific common norm, all-profile scalar tail and renewal certificates
all-length fixed-simple-path encoding; no conditioning on a random geodesic
